# =====================================================================
# KINEMATICS. Ground = trunk_base. Rigid fasteners tie every part and servo to its link;
# revolute joints are the 14 STS3215 horn axes (+ jaw). Pivots and axes are rotated
# into the CAD CAD frame at the zero pose; axis signs and limits are the MuJoCo model's joints
# (microduck_rl simulation/joint_travel_record.json, degrees), so a CAD joint value equals
# the MuJoCo joint value in degrees. Zero pose = CAD pose; pose "home" = HOME_FRAME.
# Link ownership of each servo case was taken from which link's solid contains it.
# =====================================================================
def _rigid(link, parts):
    for p in parts:
        design.rigid(f"fix_{p}", link, p)


# trunk link: yaw servo cases, shells, battery, switch, IMU
_rigid("trunk_base", ["imu_yoke_bridge_native", "battery_donor_cover_native", "battery_carrier_native",

    yaw2roll, hip, thigh, shin, ankle = f"yaw2roll_{tag}", f"hip_{tag}", f"upper_leg_{tag}", f"leg_{tag}", f"ankle_{tag}"
    # fasteners: servo cases belong to the link whose solid holds them
    _rigid(yaw2roll, [s_roll])
    _rigid(thigh, [s_pitch, s_knee])
    # the bearing inner cap screws to the shin (MuJoCo body leg / leg_2); the outer keeper rides the ankle
    _rigid(shin, [s_ankle, f"ankle_bearing_inner_cap_{tag}"])
    _rigid(ankle, [f"ankle_eye_{tag}", f"ankle_bearing_outer_keeper_{tag}",
                   f"sole_{tag}", f"foot_a_{tag}", f"foot_b_{tag}"])

    design.revolute(f"{tag}_hip_yaw", "trunk_base", yaw2roll, ((23.625 * y, -8.1, 120.25), (0, 0, -1)), limits=(-100.0, 100.0))
    design.revolute(f"{tag}_hip_roll", yaw2roll, hip, ((23.625 * y, -30.375, 100.375), (0, -1, 0)), limits=(-31.0, 31.0))
